chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Ghayath ibn Ibrahim, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
There is no problem with the boy who has not yet reached puberty leading the people (in prayer) and giving the Adhan.

key_terms.يَؤُمَّ: To lead in prayer (as an Imam)
key_terms.يُؤَذِّنَ: To give the Adhan (call to prayer)

ai.seo_question: Can a young boy who hasn't reached puberty lead prayers or give the Adhan?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that the validity of the prayer (sahih al-salah) is not contingent upon the imam reaching full legal maturity (bulugh), but rather on his ability to recite the Quran correctly and maintain ritual purity. This ruling distinguishes between the permissibility of a child leading prayer and the preferred status of an adult, reflecting the Imami view that minor defects in the leader do not invalidate the congregation's worship. It underscores the practical flexibility in communal prayer structures during the time of the Imams.
